title: Negative count threshold gate
statement: For a finite coordinate set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and an integer threshold $k\ge 0$, define a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$ that equals $−1$ when at least $k$ coordinates in $S$ are positive, and equals $1$ otherwise.
